features.user_visible_behavior: Operators build the bootc image with `ansible-playbook ansible/playbooks/bootc_build.yaml` (render first, publish after) instead of an ad-hoc shell script; the pipeline is three reproducible Ansible stages (render -> build -> publish).

evidence: 2026-06-17 implemented ansible/roles/bootc_build/{tasks,defaults,README}.md and wired ansible/playbooks/bootc_build.yaml (loads images/build-vars.example.yml, runs bootc_build on localhost). 2026-06-17 LIVE BUILD+PUSH through the new role (operator-approved). op run --env-file images/op-run.build.example -- ansible-playbook render_bootc_image_context.yml then bootc_build.yaml -e bootc_build_tag=rhel10-bootc-20260617.3 -e bootc_base_image=registry.redhat.io/rhel10/rhel-bootc:latest: bootc_build built quay.io/ncdv/rhel10-base:rhel10-bootc-20260617.3 (RHSM passed as --secret src tempfiles, removed after). features.notes: Done and live-verified through the role: render -> bootc_build -> bootc_publish produced quay.io/ncdv/rhel10-base:rhel10-bootc-20260617.3. The local script /tmp/build_and_push_rhel10.sh is retired. Reuses the temp-secret/no_log/cleanup idiom from bootc_publish and the become+argv + require-rendered-context idiom from convert_bootc_to_qcow2.yml. bootc_build does not render and does not push, matching the single-responsibility split of the other stages.
